title: Low exact character orders need no endpoint cancellation
statement: Let ell>=200, n in {2ell+1,2ell+2}, c=ceil(log2 ell), a=ell-c-1, and Q be the largest power of two with 3cQ<=ell. The proved individual-Weil envelopes for all conductor levels below a and all exact-order layers of order at most Q in a<=j<=ell, together with a factor-4ell saving only for exact orders greater than Q, are strictly below the Lemire endpoint discrepancy budget 2^(2ell).

evidence.supports: The exact low-conductor, low-order, conditional high-order, and target integers for both endpoint parities.
evidence.notes: The universal proof uses closed geometric sums and h_(j,Q)=2^(j-floor(j/Q)); bounded rows through 1024 plus dyadic controls through 16384 are mutation tests.

notes: At ell=200 the cutoff is 8, so 20 of 67 nonempty order layers are discharged unconditionally. This fact proves an implication; it does not establish the remaining high-order saving.
